caveats: Folding models are untrained on our data (their own learned weights); runtime is CPU-only inference, no training performed here.
Dot-bracket paired state is the primary output of all three models; continuous BPP not exposed by these CLI wrappers.
Point-gain is an aggregate difference; full cluster-bootstrap CI requires per-position scores of our model on the same validation set (see EPRO_DEV_06 run_manifest predictions).
